items.source: This provides an alternative to the default bean name generation for @Bean methods (which uses the plain method name), primarily for use in large applications with potential bean name overlaps. Favor this bean naming strategy over FullyQualifiedAnnotationBeanNameGenerator if you expect such naming conflicts for @Bean methods, as long as the application does not depend on @Bean method names as bean names. Where the name does matter, make sure to declare @Bean("myBeanName") in such a scenario, even if it repeats the method name as the bean name.
items.translation: 这为 `@Bean` 方法的默认 Bean 名称生成（使用纯方法名）提供了一种替代方案，主要用于大型应用中可能存在的 Bean 名称重叠。如果您预计 `@Bean` 方法会出现此类命名冲突，只要应用程序不依赖于 `@Bean` 方法名作为 Bean 名称，就应优先采用这种 Bean 命名策略，而不是使用 `FullyQualifiedAnnotationBeanNameGenerator`。在名称确实重要的情况下，即使该方法名与 Bean 名称重复，也请在此类场景中声明 `@Bean("myBeanName")`。

items.source: Derive a default bean name for the given @Bean method, providing the name attribute specified.
items.translation: 为给定的 @Bean 方法推导默认 Bean 名称，同时提供指定的 name 属性。

items.source: A convenient constant for a default FullyQualifiedConfigurationBeanNameGenerator instance, as used for configuration-level import purposes.
items.translation: 一个用于配置级别导入目的的默认 `FullyQualifiedConfigurationBeanNameGenerator` 实例的便捷常量。

items.source: beanName - the name attribute or null if non is specified
items.translation: beanName - name 属性或如果未指定则为 null

items.source: beanMethod - the method metadata for the @Bean method
items.translation: beanMethod - @Bean 方法的元数据

items.source: the default bean name to use
items.translation: 要使用的默认 Bean 名称
